title: Wayfare Pass Billing Standard — Unused-Period Portion on a Move to All Access Annual
content:
# Unused-period portion on a move to All Access Annual (Wayfare Pass)

**Standard.** When a Wayfare Pass (rider membership) membership moves up to Wayfare Pass All Access Annual, the unused-period value is the membership fees collected for the period in force less the fee refunds booked against them, multiplied by the unused-period portion and rounded half up to the cent. The unused-period portion depends on the timing and on the plan: where the latest membership fee charge is no more than the plan's full refund window in calendar days old on the change date and no Pass ride credit has been posted for the period, the portion is the whole period; for an annual plan otherwise, the portion is the whole calendar months of the period, counted from the period start's day of month, that begin after the change date, over twelve; otherwise the portion is the days from the change date through the last day of the period, both days counted, over the days in the period, both end days counted.

## Plan figures (the plan held before the move)

| Plan | Full refund window (calendar days) | Billing period | Portion outside the first tier |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | 2 | monthly | days |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | 2 | monthly | days |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | 30 | annual | whole months over twelve |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | 2 | monthly | days |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | 30 | annual | whole months over twelve |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | 30 | annual | whole months over twelve |

## Points of judgement

- The age of the latest charge is the number of calendar days from the date of the latest membership fee charge on the membership ledger to the change date: on a 30-day window, 30 days old is inside and 31 is not; on a 2-day window, 2 is inside and 3 is not.
- A single credit earn entry for the period in force takes the membership out of the first tier.
- Whole months are counted from the period start's day of month; a month that begins on the change date itself does not begin after it.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

1. Wayfare Pass Annual, period beginning 10 January, 96.00 charged on 10 January, change on 25 April: the charge is beyond 30 days; months beginning after 25 April are 10 May through 10 December, 8 of 12; with nothing refunded the unused-period value is 64.00.
2. Wayfare Pass Plus Annual, 199.00 charged 12 days before the change date, no credit earn entry for the period: the portion is the whole period, and the unused-period value is 199.00.
3. The same membership with two credit earn entries for the period, change in the first month of the period: 11 whole months begin after the change date, so the portion is 11 over 12 and the unused-period value is 182.42.
